whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Wushu Martial Arts Academy,

I noticed your martial arts academy has built strong community trust in Kurji, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new student admissions and batch inquiries.

Maine aapke academy ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, self-defense & training programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/wushu

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Wushu Martial Arts Academy team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke martial arts academy ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking and training schedule showcases for your Kurji center. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"
